assets.name: core
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent component layer for compositing the existing realistic Riviel ship. Image 1 is the edit target and authoritative photographic appearance, camera and EXACT screen-space layout. Exact 1632x960 landscape canvas, preserve all retained component pixel positions and scale. Do not trim, recenter, expand or redesign. Photoreal machined metal, restrained ribbed surfaces, existing cool studio light, preserve beautiful original shape. Genuine transparent alpha background and all empty gaps. No text, glow, stars, ground shadows, colored edge fringes or backdrop. Isolate ONLY the central needle-shaped ship CORE: silver long leftward nose, coaxial cylindrical collars and open axial spaceframe, larger rear cylindrical hub, aft shaft. Remove the entire dark curved cup wing, its upper/lower curved edge rails and all wing membrane. Reconstruct only small portions of core hidden by the wing, maintaining straight coaxial joints and the existing elegant core silhouette. Complete the open frame's missing longitudinal connections so every axial beam actually meets its matching forward and aft collars. All components must be one connected mechanical assembly with true straight shafts. Keep modest small mounting lugs on the forward collar at about x38%,y48%, main aft hub at x64%,y49% and rear shaft collar near x86%,y48%; wing braces will attach at these stations in a separate layer. No wings or radial sail panels. Keep the needle at x1%-40%,y48%; rear cylindrical assembly in x~57%-91%,y48% exactly as reference. Central ship core ONLY on the same full transparent canvas.
assets.export: Full canvas resampled to 1632x960 preserving alpha; no trimming or recentering.

assets.name: wing
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Riviel curved cup WING component on transparent canvas. Image 1 is the current wing-only edit target. Preserve the existing beautiful concave cup membrane, curvature, perspective, metallic finish, framing and all component positions. Make the BOTTOM INSIDE EDGE a smooth uninterrupted flowing curve from its inward end around the broad cup rim: remove the large round knobby NODULE/boss at approximately x68%,y64% where the inner bottom rim starts, and remove its short diagonal brace leading upward. Blend the rim into a graceful continuous thin metallic curved lip, with no ball joint, swelling, knot, cap or abrupt corner interrupting that lower inner edge. Also REMOVE braces coming off the WINGTIPS: the diagonal bar from the narrow left tip toward x39%,y47% and the small rod/bars projecting from the far right tip toward the ship. Remove their tip attachment nodules, leaving smooth natural tapered wing tips. Keep the cup's structural edge rails themselves, which follow its surface curve, and the quiet mid-wing mounting point at the main hub station for a separate core composite. This remains a wing-only layer: no needle-shaped central core or new hull pieces. Clear removed brace regions to genuine transparent alpha where outside membrane, restore ribbed curved wing membrane where a removed nodule occluded it. No background, glow, text, stars, floor, extra details or redesign. Exact 1632x960 full canvas, no cropping, recentering or scaling.
assets.export: Full canvas resampled to 1632x960 with alpha; no trimming or recentering.

assets.prompt: Use case: compositing. Image 1 is the complete Riviel ship EDIT TARGET, exact 1632x960 transparent canvas. Repair only the missing INNER CUP SURFACE of image 1, using the UNBROKEN surface from image 2 behind the central ship core. In image 1 there is an erroneous transparent strip immediately UNDER the straight upper structural rail and ABOVE the central needle hull, starting around (480,365) and continuing past (550,390), (650,395), (800,400), (900,405). FILL that strip with the physically continuous ribbed inner wing membrane from image 2. The cup is one continuous opaque sheet: the straight upper rail does NOT bound a cut-out. The inner membrane must extend across and below that rail, through the space above the hull, behind the hull and into the lower curving wing lip. It must be visibly present even in all gaps through the central core's open metal trusses when the cup is behind them. Treat the authoritative wing as a solid rear layer whose alpha shape cannot be cut away by compositing the front core. Inside the cup's outer contour, NO see-through triangle between upper rail and hull, no notches, empty strips, missing membranes or view of the background. At (550,390), (650,395), (800,400) opacity must be fully opaque inner ribbed membrane, not transparent. Outside the existing wing/hull exterior silhouette retain true transparent alpha. Preserve every current foreground needle core pixel, collar, shaft, gold/silver reflection, placement and geometry. Preserve the cup's outer silhouette and photographic ribbed material and lighting from image 2, preserve the smooth lower INNER rim with NO nodule, preserve removed wingtip braces, do NOT restore projecting braces or bosses. SAME camera, scale and full framing, no recentering or cropping. Change ONLY the lost inner wing surface; do not redesign or relight the ship. No stars, background, text or propulsion effects.
